name: n8n-clay-apollo-account-expansion-radar
description: Scheduled n8n workflow that scans HubSpot customer accounts for expansion trigger events (executive hiring spikes, new technology, funding, headcount growth) via Apollo and Clay, then creates HubSpot custom-object signal records, expansion tasks and an upsell-play handoff, with Slack alerts.
author: DH Robin (dhRobin Systems)

scripts.lint: node --check src/config.js && node --check src/radarEngine.js && node --check scripts/build-workflow.js && node --check test/radarEngine.test.js && node --check test/workflow.test.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('workflow.json','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build:check && npm test
